moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: I resigned from Anthropic today… the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.
moments.why: A mid‑level researcher’s blunt warning about AI risk hit 100M+ views in under 24 hours and sparked global alarm.

moments.author: Evan Hubinger
moments.quote: Jacob is correct here – we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans! I personally think it is >10% within the next decade.
moments.why: One of Anthropic’s own alignment leads publicly agreed, lending rare internal confirmation to the doomsday warning.

moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: “Pacing” development doesn’t mean stopping — progress has been rapid and will continue to be.
moments.why: OpenAI’s CEO pushed back on calls to slow AI, reinforcing urgency amid safety alarm sparked by the viral resignation.
